videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, approximately 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences covering the key points.
Key points from the transcript:
1. National Assembly started investigation procedures regarding the shortage of ballot papers in local elections
2. Election Commission admitted it was a distribution failure, not shortage - they had 42,000 papers remaining in Songpa-gu overall but failed to distribute properly to polling stations
3. Issues revealed: 8 Seoul districts reduced print quantities through written resolution without official meetings; 1,100 votes missing in Jeonbuk education governor election due to computer input errors; used unnumbered emergency ballots mixed with regular ones (70% were unnumbered); only 2,000 emergency ballots prepared instead of required 17,000
4. Prosecution and police joint investigation team conducted raids (압수수색) for 13 hours at 7 locations including Central Election Commission
5. Investigation is heading toward top officials (칼끝 윗선 향하나)
I need to write this in Korean only, no English, around 500 characters, 3-5 sentences.
